metadata.description: Ironwallet for AI agents: non-custodial hot wallet, transfers, and Swap Proxy swaps. Seeds stay on the machine.

plugins.name: ironwallet-mcp
plugins.description: The Ironwallet MCP server gives AI agents a non-custodial hot wallet on the host machine. Seed phrases stay encrypted locally and never leave the host. Agents can check balances, transfer tokens, and swap via Swap Proxy across 10+ networks (EVM, Tron, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, TON).
